'''Farpoint Tower''' was a tower located in the settlement of [[Farpoint]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fhost]]. After a [[Brawl in the Black Hole|brawl]] in the [[Black Hole (Fhost)|Black Hole]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], [[Khedryn Faal]] commed Farpoint Tower as he was taking off in the [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Junker'']] with [[Marr Idi-Shael]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]], but did not wait for a response before leaving.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
